en: Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a tree-filled park with benches and people in early 20th‑century clothing. On the left stands a large monument with a tall statue of a standing figure atop a multi-tiered pedestal (the Dante monument). On the right is a bust of a man on a high plinth (Giuseppe Verdi). Distant mountains are visible beyond the trees. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.
